postings.title: Comanche Peak Nuclear Power Plant Scaffolders
postings.body:
Comanche Peak Nuclear Power Plant

Open call for Carpenters and Millwrights. This is a Scaffold assignment.

Need Scaffold Builders APP5 to JM 

Must Have Osha 10 Construction and Scaffold 40 quals

JM Hourly Wage of $36.47, Apprentices will receive their appropriate rates.

Fringe Benefits of $10.59

Please be advised, NO Per Diem. The work schedule will consist of six 12-hour shifts, with the project anticipated to be concluded on November 11. 

Great opportunity to get your Nuclear Red Badge.

Please Call Mayra Gutierrez 682-460-4060 or call 817-784-0429

Thank you,

    
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 "UBC millwrights have provided us with a fantastic resource for labor and opened up all kinds of opportunities that we didn’t have access to before."

 
 Greg Moharin, Vice President, Newell Machinery
postings.verify_note: Posted by the United Brotherhood of Carpenters/Millwrights, not by an individual local hall. Always verify with the listed contact before you travel.

postings.title: Millwright AWS Certified Welders Needed
postings.body:
Contractor: Western Industrial (WIC)

Job Site: FedEx Memphis TN 38

Start: Monday Oct 21, 2026

Duration: Long Term 2 yrs

Scope: Millwright AWS Certified Welders to install conveyor systems

Wage: $34.07 Journeymen

Apprentices at their appropriate apprentice percentage

Welders: $35.07

Fringe Benefits: 

H&W $5.50

Pension $5.75

Supp. Pension $4.57

Shift: Days 5/10's

No Per Diem

Call Breanna Collins LU 1554 (901)633-2972

    
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 "In today’s environment, you have to continuously be improving. The UBC millwrights are the most highly qualified people that can be on a jobsite."

 
 Rick Rives, President, Atlantic Plant Maintenance

postings.title: Interior Systems Carpenters Needed Various
postings.body:
Interior Systems Carpenters Needed 

Various Companies.

Various Projects in Nashville and Surrounding Areas

Hourly $28 

Fringe Benefits $5.88

Per diem $12.50 an hour for every hour worked.

If interested, please call one of these Business Reps.

Call Ernesto Arias 865-323-7429

Call Gilberto Granados 629-213-1500

Call Jorge Lara 205-317-6579

If you know someone interested, please have them call to get evaluated and if not a member of the UBC to join. 

Millwrights with Interior Systems experience / training are welcoming to apply.

Thank you,

    
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 "The union gave us 100 percent support and created an environment of partnership, relationship, and respect. It was a true success for everybody involved, and the UBC millwrights were the key."

 
 Salvatore DeBiase, Site Project Supervisor, Composite Cooling Solutions
